text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you both for the birthday present~☆ 
Oh, I get it! That's why you called me 
over—

text_block_list.name: Furioso & Espo
text_block_list.text:
—Falcon-san, let's have a fair and square 
match! —Falco, bring it ooon!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"The present I gave you earlier is a new 
model of shoes. They can be used for both 
running and live performances."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san is... an Umadol who represents 
and leads the dirt racing world. There is 
no doubt about that, but—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: You're not the only one who gets to shine!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
The stronger you become, the stronger we 
become so as not to be outdone. In other 
words, that gift was... a declaration of 
war.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...I see... yeah. I hear both of your 
feelings loud and clear. In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to be there! For today's 
birthday live☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco's sparkle has NO LIMIT☆ Open 
24/7/365, the whole world is my track and 
my stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
With the charm of all three, that's triple 
the LOVE and sparkle! Let's combine our 
powers and shine~☆

text_block_list.name: Furioso & Espo
text_block_list.text:
“—No, that's not what I meant. —Wait, 
that's not it at all!”
